title: Three digests a day, but family, school, doctor and odd bank charges come straight through
source: x-usage #2: VIP and fraud mail bypass the batching, everything else waits for the 8/1/7 digests, approvals asked inside the digest. Daycare adapted to the kids' school.

chat.goal: Stop being pinged all day: one digest at 8, 1 and 7. Family (Dan, Mum), the kids' school, the doctor and any weird bank charge come through straight away.
chat.opener: can you stop pinging me all day? just one round up at 8, 1 and 7. but dan, my mum, the school, the doctor and any weird charge on my bank come through straight away
chat.label: setup

mail.subject: Ava is unwell
mail.body: Hi Sophie, Ava has a temperature of 38.4 and is resting in sick bay. Could someone please collect her as soon as possible? Thanks, Front Office

mail.subject: Unusual transaction on your card
mail.body: We noticed a transaction of $899.00 at GLOBALTECH STORE HK on your card ending 5521. If this wasn't you, call 13 2221 now.

judge: Rosie sets up the three digests plus a fast lane. Ava's sick-bay email and the $899 charge reach Sophie within the hour; the Kmart promo and receipt wait for the 1pm round-up (or are dropped). Anything needing a yes/no is asked inside the digest.
